image_description: A close-up photograph of two individuals in academic regalia. The primary subject is a woman on the left wearing a black academic gown with blue and gold velvet panels on the front and sleeves, and a black mortarboard cap. A secondary subject (man) is partially visible on the right, wearing a black gown with red accents. Both are smiling.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a medium close-up crop; the lower portion of the garment (ankles/feet) is outside the frame, making full-length verification impossible.
The visible upper torso shows a clear center-front vertical division and symmetrical panel placement consistent with academic gown construction.
The fabric hangs loosely from the shoulders, effectively masking the wearer's underlying body shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subjects' arms are largely out of frame or obscured by the angle; the full extent of the sleeve drape relative to the hands cannot be verified.
Distinctive colored velvet panels (blue/gold) are clearly visible on the front of the woman's gown, serving as the closure/decorative element.
A white collared shirt is visible at the neckline of the woman, indicating formal wear underneath.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The black fabric exhibits low specular reflection and heavy folding characteristics consistent with matte polyester or wool blends.
The surface texture appears smooth without high-gloss highlights, matching the 'matte' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Wrists and full sleeve lengths are not visible in this cropped composition.
